# mapping

`binding_table`, `engine_key`, `action`, `physical_input`, `stick_layout`, and `glyph_family` define controller-input translation from physical devices to engine keys, logical commands, button layouts, stick axes, and presentation labels.

## Contents

### Binding Storage

- [binding.hpp](./binding.hpp) declares `binding_table`, `apply_button_layout`, and engine-key-to-command binding operations.
- [binding.cpp](./binding.cpp) implements `binding_table::bind`, `unbind`, `clear`, `command_for`, `for_each`, `size`, and `apply_button_layout`.

### Key and Glyph Mapping

- [key.hpp](./key.hpp) declares `engine_key`, `all_engine_keys`, `engine_key_count`, and key lookup APIs.
- [key.cpp](./key.cpp) implements `key_index`, `key_name`, `key_from_name`, `key_from_keynum`, and `is_controller_key`.
- [glyph.hpp](./glyph.hpp) declares `glyph_family`, `glyph_family_for`, and `glyph_for`.
- [glyph.cpp](./glyph.cpp) implements controller-family selection and key glyph resolution.

### Logical and Physical Inputs

- [logical.hpp](./logical.hpp) declares `action`, `to_string(action)`, and `command(action)`.
- [logical.cpp](./logical.cpp) maps logical actions to canonical names and engine command strings.
- [physical.hpp](./physical.hpp) declares `stick_direction`, `apad_input`, `physical_input`, and `to_engine_key` overloads.
- [physical.cpp](./physical.cpp) maps `button` and `apad_input` values to `engine_key` values and implements `axis_deflected`.

### Stick Layouts

- [stick-layout.hpp](./stick-layout.hpp) declares `virtual_axis`, `stick_layout`, `resolved_axes`, `axis_for`, `resolve`, and layout-name conversion APIs.
- [stick-layout.cpp](./stick-layout.cpp) implements stick permutation, squared movement scaling, and layout-name parsing.

## File Relationships

`physical_input` dispatches through `to_engine_key` into `engine_key`, while `binding_table` indexes commands through `key_index` and iterates `all_engine_keys`. `logical::command` supplies command strings consumed by `binding_table::bind`, and `apply_button_layout` combines `action`, `engine_key`, and layout-name flags. `glyph_for` resolves labels through `key_name`, while `glyph_family_for` selects `playstation` or `xbox` from `controller::family`.

## Behavioral Contracts

`engine_key` contains 24 stable values, and `all_engine_keys` preserves their enumeration order for `key_index`, `key_name`, and `binding_table::commands_`.

`key_names` contains exactly `engine_key_count` entries enforced by `static_assert`, including `BUTTON_A`, `BUTTON_B`, `BUTTON_X`, `BUTTON_Y`, `BUTTON_LSHLDR`, `BUTTON_RSHLDR`, `BUTTON_START`, `BUTTON_BACK`, `BUTTON_LSTICK`, `BUTTON_RSTICK`, `BUTTON_LTRIG`, `BUTTON_RTRIG`, `DPAD_UP`, `DPAD_DOWN`, `DPAD_LEFT`, `DPAD_RIGHT`, `APAD_UP`, `APAD_DOWN`, `APAD_LEFT`, `APAD_RIGHT`, `RSTICK_UP`, `RSTICK_DOWN`, `RSTICK_LEFT`, and `RSTICK_RIGHT`.

`engine_key::rstick_right` remains below `256` for direct indexing into the engine key-state array.

`to_string(action)` returns labels including `"jump-stand"`, `"use-reload"`, `"next-weapon"`, `"special-grenade"`, and `"action-slot-1..4"`, while `command(action)` returns `"+attack"`, `"+speed_throw"`, `"+gostand"`, `"+stance"`, `"+melee"`, `"+usereload"`, `"+breath_sprint"`, `"weapnext"`, `"+frag"`, `"+smoke"`, `"togglemenu"`, `"+scores"`, and `"+actionslot 1..4"`.

`scoreboard` maps to `"+scores"`; `togglescores` remains unbound.

`apply_button_layout` lowercases names and detects `tactical`, `lefty`, `nomad`, and `_alt`; unknown names fall back to the default layout.

`axis_deflected` computes `threshold = pressed + (was_down ? -hysteresis : hysteresis)` and tests `value > threshold` for positive axes or `value < -threshold` for negative axes.

`stick_layout_from_name` recognizes `"thumbstick_default"`, `"thumbstick_southpaw"`, `"thumbstick_legacy"`, and `"thumbstick_legacysouthpaw"`, testing `"thumbstick_legacysouthpaw"` before shorter matches; unknown names return `stick_layout::standard`.

`squared` returns `std::clamp(v.magnitude() * component, -1.0f, 1.0f)`, while `resolve` preserves raw `yaw` and `pitch` components.

`glyph_family_for` honors an optional override, maps DualShock and DualSense families to `playstation`, and maps Xbox or unknown families to `xbox`; `glyph_for` ignores `glyph_family`.

## Layout Semantics

`apply_button_layout` always maps start/menu, back/scoreboard, X/use-reload, Y/next-weapon, D-pad action slots 1–4, and A/jump-stand. `tactical` swaps melee and stance assignments, `lefty` reverses trigger roles and remaps shoulder/stick actions, and `_alt` swaps default shoulder actions.

`axis_for` applies Southpaw stick swapping, while `stick_layout::legacy` additionally swaps horizontal movement and view roles; `resolve` emits `side`, `forward`, `yaw`, and `pitch` in `resolved_axes`.
